question: What parts of the body should be permeated by the fluid?
premises: The fluid is the means of permeation
The permeation should extend to all
This includes the hair pores and so forth
inference: One should permeate the entire body, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid, O beloved.
plain_english: One should color the whole body, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid, O beloved.
